# Shared Workspace Access Patterns

## Access modes
- local GUI
- local CLI
- remote CLI over SSH
- remote attach to active workspace/session
- multi-user shared review/planning presence
- agent-native execution against same workspace truth

## Principle
Different access paths should converge on the same objects, sessions, chronicle, bindings, and approvals.
